sentences.text: Robert Norman Ross -LRB- October 29 , 1942 -- July 4 , 1995 -RRB- was an American painter , art instructor , and television host .	art instructor	Visual arts education

He was the creator and host of The Joy of Painting , an instructional television program that aired from 1983 to 1994 on PBS in the United States , and also aired in Canada , Latin America , and Europe .	The Joy of Painting	The Joy of Painting	PBS	PBS

With a soft voice and a permed afro , Ross went from being a television personality in the 1980s and 1990s to an Internet celebrity popular with fans on YouTube and many other websites .	permed	Perm (hairstyle)	afro	afro	YouTube	YouTube
